operations.name: dock.close_group
operations.description: Close every panel in the right-dock tab group that currently holds the given panel (PS "Close Tab Group"). Reopen panels individually with dock.open_panel. Browser UI only.

panel.description: Any dock panel id in the target group

operations.name: dock.close_panel
operations.description: Close a right-dock panel by id: it leaves the dock and the workspace layout but keeps its state; bring it back with dock.open_panel. Browser UI only.

panel.description: Dock panel id, such as history, color, or navigator

operations.name: dock.dock_panel
operations.description: Dock a floating panel back into the right-dock. Optionally target a column/group/edge for drop parity with drag behavior.

panel.description: Dock panel id, such as history, color, or navigator

group.description: Optional zero-based group index in the target column

index.description: Optional tab index inside the target group

new_group.description: True to create a new group at the insertion point

new_column.description: True to create a brand-new column at the target index and place this panel/group there

operations.name: dock.float_panel
operations.description: Float a right-dock panel into a free window. Optionally pass x/y for the popup position and whole=true to move the whole tab group.

panel.description: Dock panel id, such as history, color, or navigator

x.description: Optional screen-space X for the floating panel top-left

y.description: Optional screen-space Y for the floating panel top-left

whole.description: Optional true to float the entire tab group that contains this panel

operations.name: dock.get
operations.description: Get the browser right-dock workspace layout: column collapsed state, each group active panel, collapsed state, and split size, plus the ids of closed panels.

operations.name: dock.list_panels
operations.description: List every right-dock panel with id, title, and open state. Closed panels can be reopened with dock.open_panel. Browser UI only.

operations.name: dock.move_panel
operations.description: Move a dock panel tab to another column/group/index. Set new_group to stack a new group at the insertion point, or new_column to create a whole new dock column (side "left" docks it left of the canvas, like Photoshop). Browser UI only.

panel.description: Dock panel id to move, such as layers, actions, color, or properties

to_column.description: Zero-based target dock column index, or the flat insertion index when new_column is true

to_group.description: Zero-based target group index, or group insertion index when new_group is true

index.description: Zero-based tab index inside the target group

new_group.description: True to create a new group at to_group instead of joining an existing tab bar

new_column.description: True to create a brand-new dock column at to_column holding just this panel

operations.name: dock.open_panel
operations.description: Open a right-dock panel by id. A closed panel returns to its home group by default, or to an explicit column/group; an already-open panel is activated. Browser UI only.

panel.description: Dock panel id, such as history, color, or navigator

column.description: Optional zero-based target dock column index; omit to reopen at the panel home group

group.description: Optional zero-based group index in the target column; omitted or out of range appends a new group

operations.name: dock.reveal_panel
operations.description: Reveal a right-dock panel by id. This expands its column, uncollapses its group, activates the tab, and returns the resulting dock layout. Browser UI only.

panel_id.description: Dock panel id, such as layers, actions, color, or properties

operations.name: dock.set_column
operations.description: Set whether a right-dock column is collapsed to its icon strip. Browser UI only.

collapsed.description: True to collapse the column to icons; false to expand it

operations.name: dock.set_group
operations.description: Set a right-dock group active panel, collapsed state, or split size. Browser UI only.

group_index.description: Zero-based group index within the column

active.description: Optional panel id to activate in the group

size.description: Optional positive split weight for this group

operations.name: dock.set_pref
operations.description: Set right-dock workspace prefs: auto_collapse_icons (fly-outs close on outside click) and auto_show_hidden (persisted; hover-reveal not implemented yet). Persisted with the workspace. Browser UI only.

auto_collapse_icons.description: Auto-close icon-strip fly-outs when clicking elsewhere

auto_show_hidden.description: Auto-show hidden panels on edge hover (stored pref; no behavior yet)
